stemMd: A rhombus has diagonals 10 cm and 24 cm. What is its perimeter?
explanationMd: The diagonals bisect at right angles. A side is the hypotenuse of legs 5 and 12, hence 13 cm; four sides total 52 cm.

distractorRationale.c: Adds whole diagonal lengths instead of side lengths.
distractorRationale.d: Reports the area instead of the perimeter.
distractorRationale.a: Doubles the sum of diagonal lengths.
